title: Northgate Store and Online Orders: Addition for Earlier Changed-Mind Returns on the Same Order
content:
**Restocking addition for earlier changed-mind returns on the same order.** A changed-mind Drive Up return of an electronics-class line of a Northgate Same-Day Delivery order under **Northgate Store and Online Orders** carries a restocking addition counted by the returns already recorded on the same order with the reason changed mind:

| Earlier changed-mind returns on the order | Restocking addition |
|---|---|
| two or more | 5 percent |
| one | 2 percent |
| none | nothing |

Returns recorded for any other reason, and returns on other orders, are not counted.
